name: Myuu-tan ni Omakase!
original_name: みゅうたんにおまかせ！
source:
Main character takes a nap when door opens and beautiful girl jumps in. "I'm a helper from the future! I will solve your love troubles!" From this day his life becomes anything but ordinary.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-march-2007-shirogane-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公正在午睡，突然门开了，一个美丽的女孩跳了进来。“我是来自未来的帮手！我会解决你的恋爱烦恼！”从这一天起，他的生活变得再也不平凡了。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-march-2007-shirogane-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
